versions.subject: Merge PR #5533 from @swachchhanda000 - fix: github reported issues
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\BaaUpdate.exe'
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '.dll'
    ImageLoaded|contains:
        - ':\Perflogs\'
        - ':\Users\Default\'
        - ':\Users\Public\'
        - ':\Windows\Temp\'
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\AppData\Roaming\'
        - '\Contacts\'
        - '\Favorites\'
        - '\Favourites\'
        - '\Links\'
        - '\Music\'
        - '\Pictures\'
        - '\ProgramData\'
        - '\Temporary Internet'
        - '\Videos\'
condition: selection
